RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, the August 14, 2006/Sravana 23, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Development of North Eastern Region; Earth Sciences; Food

Mines; Minority Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
People educated under NLM in U.P.
*281. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons male and
female separately, in the age group of 15-35
educated under the National Literacy
Mission in Uttar Pradesh during the last
three years ending on the 31st March, 2006,
year-wise; and
(b) how the literacy level in Uttar
Pradesh as on the 31st March, 2006 is
compared with the national level?
Ragging in schools/colleges
†*282. DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether students have to very often
go through harsh mental torture and
humiliating conditions in the name of ragging
in schools/colleges;
(b) whether incidents of committing
suicides, falling mentally ill and leaving the
school or college by the victims have come
to light; and
(c) whether Government have taken or
propose to take any stringent action to save
the students from this kind of situation
and if so, the details thereof?
Steps to increase awareness against
drugs
*283. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI : Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have taken any
steps so far to launch drug awareness among
the young people;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that street children
and children with disabilities are more
vulnerable; and

(d) if so, whether Government are taking
any steps to prevent such children from drug
abuse?
Reduction in the number of drop-out
children
†*284. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the plan of Government
to reduce the number of drop-out children
under Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan in the
country;
(b) the results achieved in this direction
after implementation of the above plan;
(c) to what extent 'Mid-day Meal'
scheme has been effective in this direction;
(d) whether any review has been made
as to what extent these schemes of Central
Government have been effective; and
(e) if so, whether any shortcomings have
been found in these schemes during such
review and if so, the measures being taken
to remove them?
Setting up of private sector food
processing units in Jharkhand
*285. MISS MABEL REBELLO : Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the private sector units set up in
Jharkhand for food processing;
(b) the total investment that has come to
the State in the food processing sector; and
(c) the steps Government are taking to
improve the food processing industry in
Jharkhand?
Allocation of power from central
generating station
*286. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has reduced the unallocated quota of power
from the central generating station to
Gujarat;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government of Gujarat has
requested Central Government to reconsider
the decision;
(d) if so, Government's stand on the
request of Government of Gujarat;
(e) by what time the original quota shall
be restored to Gujarat;
(f) whether it is also a fact that Gujarat
faces heavy peak power shortage; and
(g) if so, the reasons due to which the
unallocated quota of central generating
station has been diverted to other State?
Coastal line of Gujarat
*287. SHRI PRAVEEN RASHTRAPAL:
Will the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be
pleased to state:
(a) the length of coastal line of Gujarat;
(b) whether there is any college, institute
or university in Gujarat doing work or
research on oceanography;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether there is any proposal to
establish such an institute in Gujarat; and
(e) the details of institutes on
oceanography in India and whether Gujarat
is being ignored inspite of vast coastline?

89
Hindi in Kendriya Vidyalayas
*288. SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that knowledge
of Hindi has been made compulsory for
the posts of teachers in Kendriya Vidyalayas
since 1986; and
(b) if so, whether Government would
withdraw this provision in view of the fact
that well qualified candidates from Tamil
Nadu are debarred from applying for the
posts of teachers in Kendriya Vidyalayas?
Area studies programmes of UGC
*289. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister

List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS

Sources; Power; Science and Technology; Social Justice

Total number of questions — 155
Projects for development of NER
1949. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to refer to
the answer to Unstarred Question 1965 given
in the Rajya Sabha on the 12th December,
2005  and state:
(a) the development projects out of those
referred therein which have been completed
by 1st August, 2006; and
(b) the steps taken to expedite the
completion of the remaining projects?
Amount given to NGOs of NER
1950. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH EASTERN
REGION be pleased to state:
(a) the total amount of money
sanctioned by his Ministry to various
NGOs of North Eastern Region during the
last three years;
(b) the details of the projects together
with the amount sanctioned to individual
NGOs with their names in Assam;
(c) the status of the projects undertaken
for implementation by the NGOs as on date;
(d) whether Government have any plan
to give priority to a particular sector such as
health, agriculture, food processing, non-
conventional energy etc. during the current
financial year; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Schemes for sea food industry in the
coastal States
1951. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to implement any special scheme to
improve sea food industry in the coastal
States taking into account the vast manpower
and infrastructure available there;

450
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the details of revenue generated
through the sea food processing industries
in Tamil Nadu during the last five years?
Laws on food safety
1952. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of FOOD
PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) the major laws on food safety to be
followed;
(b) the number of adulteration cases
reported to his Ministry; and
(c) the action taken on each of such
cases?
Setting up of Mega Food Park in U.P.
1953. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
the proposal for setting up a ‘Mega Food
Park’ in Uttar Pradesh, being the maximum
food producing State in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when
it is expected to be set up and where; and
(c) by when necessary financial
assistance is expected to be released for
this purpose and how much?
Network of Food Processing
Industries in A.P.
1954. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of network of food
processing industries in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) the steps being taken or proposed
to be taken by Government to train farmers,
particularly women in Andhra Pradesh in
food processing techniques;
(c) the details of financial, technical and
marketing assistance given to food
processing industries in Andhra Pradesh;
(d) whether the State nodal agencies
have been nominated in Andhra Pradesh for
coordination and promotion of food
processing sector; and
(e) if so, the details of agencies and the
details of project proposals forwarded by
these agencies to his Ministry in the last
three years?
Sale of Modern Industries (India) Ltd.
†1955. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the PSU namely Modern
Industries (India) Limited was sold to
Hindustan Lever Limited;
(b) if so, the total number of units of the
said undertaking at the time of its sale;
(c) whether all the said units are still
functional; and
(d) if not, the total number of functional
units and the total number of employees who
have been given retirement from their
service?
Wastage due to lack of storage facility
in Uttaranchal
1956. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether efforts have been made by
his Ministry to reduce the wastage due to
non-availability of storage facility in
Uttaranchal;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

451
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Health clubs in CBSE schools
†1957. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to open health clubs in CBSE schools; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
details of the proposed schools alongwith
the criteria for eligibility?
